name: India DPDP Act
description: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (India) - Comprehensive data protection legislation governing the processing of digital personal data in India

policies.requirement_description: Personal data shall only be processed for a lawful purpose after obtaining the free, specific, informed, and unambiguous consent of the Data Principal.
Personal data may only be processed for a lawful purpose for which the Data Principal has given consent, or for certain legitimate uses.
The Data Principal has the right to erasure of personal data, and Data Fiduciaries must erase personal data when it is no longer needed for the stated purpose.
In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary shall notify the Board and each affected Data Principal.
